Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
  |   |   `-- Replace injected DiagramService content-writing ownership with explicit revision operations and retention. Preserve controller/session ownership and CanvasHistoryService; the ownership tree still fits.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
  |   |   `-- Show canvasViews and generation metadata under history, and AgentChat access through the agent bridge. Establish these components before linking their detailed representations.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Reorganize around default buffered exec, optional immediate execution, supplied diagram batches and controller publication. Per-call commits no longer explain the default flow; preserve version guards, validation, layout and checkpoints.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   `-- Replace append-time revision issuance with assertion and retention of issued revisions. Explain current-only exports and revisionBoundary; history remains the checkpoint owner.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   `-- Add canvasViews outside restored checkpoint state, retained review/presentation dependencies, and startGeneration/updateGeneration. Attach generation details to these explicit history operations.
  |   `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |       `-- Replace the obsolete sole-service boundary with immutable revision operations, explicit retention, generateDiagram orchestration and separate publication. Preserve content validation and proven correspondence; link to the existing revision-operations detail on Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw) - Projection rather than duplicate it.
  |
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Reorganize around unbound/target-bound MCP, turn-bound AgentChat, current reads, buffered mutations, supplied versus generated content, and lifecycle interfaces. Preserve browser polling, WebSocket readers, proposals and workspace persistence.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |   |   `-- Separate AgentDiagrammingSessionService, AgentChatService, ChatDiagramTools and GenerationCanvasBridge. Show AgentChatService owning conversation/generation orchestration and the bridge owning child controllers while delegating browser commands. Preserve proposal/publication boundaries; include PushIntegrationService -> DiffSessionWorkflowService -> ChangeSessionService/agent as related service connections only.
  |   |-- [2] Add: Bound canvas reads and identity projection
  |   |   `-- Explain how a captured turn reaches its document and obtains editable IDs. Attach to ChatCanvasBindings and AgentDiagrammingSessionService in the backend overview; cover attachment reuse, mismatch/access checks, identity reads, currentCanvasRead small/full, aliases and anchor resolution. This develops the existing API subject.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Buffered exec, flush boundaries and mutation receipts
  |       `-- Explain commit and retry boundaries, attached to AgentDiagrammingSessionService.exec. Cover queued handles, read/prerequisite flushes, final flush, compact final-state receipts and immediate mode. Atomicity is per flushed batch: earlier flushes survive later failure; unflushed writes do not commit on script failure; uncertain batches retain replay identities.
  |
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Reorganize around context resolution, pinned revision capture, supplied submission versus generation, retained outputs and application. Show DiagramBatchService owning child DiagramEditService runs and collecting one application; preserve version guards and acknowledgement retries. Add explicit AgentContextLibrary and diagram-context storage connections before expanding them.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
  |   |   `-- Replace the single prompt-edit organization with edit/create/extend envelopes, required edit/replacement modes, pinned references, context choices and batches. Distinguish supplied edit/diagram payloads from generation requests; most request branches require restructuring.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
  |   |   `-- Generalize retained outputs to edits, creations and variants while keeping the existing lifecycle. Cancellation stops generating runs, not dispatched application; acknowledgement retries reuse prepared output.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
  |   |   `-- Add source-range resolution to the immutable snapshot model, with external readers supplying source data. Preserve hash validation, copied history and the no-direct-I/O boundary; storage belongs in the separate resolution detail.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D5] Revision and canvas bindings - output domain
  |   |   `-- Distinguish in-place rebinding, retained review variants and newly created diagrams. Keep immutable identities and checkpoint bindings; exact prepared applications are reused on retry.
  |   |-- [2] Add: DiagramBatchService preparation and publication
  |   |   `-- Attach to DiagramBatchService in the redrawn overview. Explain one captured snapshot, duplicate shared-diagram edit rejection, child preparation, collected edits/creations, indexed results, one atomic application and cancellation/retry. This expands the canvas's established edit lifecycle.
  |   `-- [2] Add: AgentContext resolution and storage
  |       `-- Attach to AgentContextService, AgentContextLibrary and DiagramEditService in the overview. Distinguish scoped in-memory uploads, durable global saved contexts and diagram-owned records with source fingerprints; explain explicit context selection versus eligible automatic reuse without repeating parsing details.
  |
  |-- 01 - Saved CanvasViews and branching  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: Saved CanvasViews and branching
  |   |   `-- Add managed generation beside manual alternatives: startGeneration pins one saved parent endpoint, creates candidate views and records run/chat metadata; updateGeneration installs finished child results. Existing branching organization remains accurate; link these operations to managed-generation detail.
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: Saved CanvasViews and branching
  |       `-- Qualify view operations with running-generation guards. Finished results update candidate endpoints without switching the live head; failed/cancelled candidates do not publish child edits. Preserve saved-endpoint branching and working-copy behavior.
  |
  |-- Central and side diagrams - Attempt 2  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: 4  FROM SUPPLIED EDIT TO SAVED CANVAS
  |       `-- Insert DiagramBatchService and child DiagramEditService preparation before submission/publication. The existing flow still fits: children collect outputs before one application. Preserve revision retention and variant/presentation distinctions; connect DiagramBatchService to its detail on the AgentContext canvas.
  |
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
  |   |   `-- Add FileChatStore, FileAgentContextRepository and FileDiagramAgentContextStore as separate storage owners. Show chat sessions, generation request receipts and child histories retained by FileChatStore through serialized temporary-file/rename writes; connect its component to AgentChat lifecycle detail.
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: PersistentLayer
  |       `-- Replace whole-document snapshot publication with persisted checkpoint publication. Preserve separate single-diagram save and workspace autosave paths; the storage/publication organization still fits.
  |
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |       `-- Update Separate operations: whole-document save_diagram obtains a version-guarded checkpoint, calls publishCheckpoint, then acknowledges the browser. Preserve incremental autosave; distinguish child-history persistence through FileChatStore from subsequent synchronization into source CanvasViews.
  |
  `-- [3] AgentChat and managed canvas generation  new canvas
      |-- AgentChat ownership and backend connections
      |   `-- Give the new conversation/generation subsystem its own overview rather than broaden the API or AgentContext canvases. Show AgentChatPanel -> AgentChatService -> CodexConnection, ChatDiagramTools, MappingChatMcpBinding and FileChatStore; AgentChatService calls GenerationCanvasBridge, which owns child controllers and delegates ordinary documents to CanvasSessionBridge. Connect from AgentChatService in the Mapping backend overview.
      |-- Conversation turns, bindings and interactive events
      |   `-- Attach to AgentChatService and MappingChatMcpBinding in this overview. Explain create/import/resume, tool snapshots/reload, captured canvas/references, request persistence before turn/start, access checks, streamed events, approvals and interruption. Imported Codex threads retain native prompt/tools; explicit reload adds current MCP tools.
      |-- Managed generation from saved view to candidate result
      |   `-- Attach to AgentChatService.genAlternatives and CanvasHistory.startGeneration. Show deduplicated requests, 1-8 candidates from one saved checkpoint, separate child chats/bindings/controllers, inherited model/effort/tools, conversation fork versus saved-context start, cleared inherited goals and one managed turn per candidate. Nested generation is rejected.
      |-- GenerationCanvasBridge execution and persistence
      |   `-- Expand the overview's GenerationCanvasBridge component: per-child queues, document checks, controller reads/mutations, retained receipts and history persistence before acknowledgement. Connect to the existing API read/batch details instead of repeating them; child execution does not require browser polling.
      `-- Completion, cancellation and reconnect recovery
          `-- Attach to AgentChatService.finishGeneration, cancelGeneration and FileChatStore. Explain terminal metadata/history retention, finished-only publication, pending-save reconciliation through stable workspace identity, cleanup and thread unsubscribe. Parent interruption cancels active children; restart marks unfinished generation failed. Generated chats remain review-only records.
